facts.text: The resort is a seafront property near Chania on Crete's coastline, spread across 100 coastal acres.
facts.excerpt: Nestled near Chania on Crete's pristine coastline, the seafront JW Marriott Crete Resort & Spa spans 100 coastal acres

facts.text: The resort is near Marathi Beach.
facts.excerpt: create lasting memories through unique hands-on activities at our resort near Marathi Beach

facts.text: The resort is secluded yet well connected, with the airport and port nearby.
facts.excerpt: Secluded yet well connected, with the airport and port nearby

facts.text: The resort was designed by Athens-based studio Block722, with green rooftops, olive and carob trees, and natural materials such as marble and wood that blend it into the landscape.
facts.excerpt: Designed by Athens-based studio Block722, each space integrates seamlessly into the landscape through green rooftops, olive and carob trees, and natural materials such as marble and wood.

facts.text: Accommodations offer panoramic sea views, private pools and living spaces.
facts.excerpt: Experience spacious accommodations with panoramic sea views, private pools and living spaces.

facts.text: The Earth-Sheltered Villa is a two-bedroom sea-view villa with a separate living area.
facts.excerpt: Two elegantly appointed bedrooms and a separate, sun-drenched living area offer generous space to relax and unwind

facts.text: Some suites, including the Deluxe Swim Up rooms and Swim Up Family Suite, have swim-up access.
facts.excerpt: Swim Up Family Suite

facts.text: Anoseas Spa is inspired by traditional Cretan healing rituals, enhanced with modern, immersive therapies.
facts.excerpt: Embark on a journey of self-discovery, inspired by traditional Cretan healing rituals and enhanced with modern, immersive therapies

facts.text: Anoseas Spa has an exclusive couple's suite, a steam bath and a KLAFS sauna.
facts.excerpt: an exclusive couple’s suite, a steam bath, a KLAFS sauna

facts.text: The spa is complemented by a sunlit yoga deck overlooking the sea and an indoor vitality pool.
facts.excerpt: Complementing the experience is a sunlit yoga deck overlooking the sea, an indoor vitality pool for moments of relaxation.

facts.text: The beach and pool areas sit on a stretch of sand and coastline beside a collection of outdoor pools.
facts.excerpt: set on a pristine stretch of sand and coastline, beside an inviting collection of outdoor pools.

facts.text: The main pool is surrounded by sweeping sea views.
facts.excerpt: Surrounded by elegant design and sweeping sea views, it offers a tranquil setting to unwind under the Cretan sun.

facts.text: The resort has three outdoor pools: an adult pool, a main pool and a kids pool.
facts.excerpt: Adult Pool (Outdoor)Main Pool (Outdoor)Kids Pool (Outdoor)

facts.text: Beach cabanas are available.
facts.excerpt: ### Cabanas

facts.text: A custom-designed parkour trail invites playful fitness, and personal trainers create tailored programs.
facts.excerpt: A custom-designed parkour trail invites playful fitness, while personal trainers create tailored programs.

facts.text: Movement options range from sunrise yoga with sea views on the wooden deck to guided hikes along the surrounding hills.
facts.excerpt: From sunrise yoga with sea views on the wooden deck, to high-intensity training, TRX, core workouts, to guided hikes along the surrounding hills.

facts.text: The Phaistos Den kids club invites younger guests to explore, create and play, inspired by Cretan culture and nature.
facts.excerpt: Younger guests are invited to explore, create and play inspired by Cretan culture and nature, in a space that offers engaging activities, creative workshops and outdoor experiences.

facts.text: Family by JW includes shaded outdoor spaces and a vegetable garden.
facts.excerpt: cultural discovery and imaginative play come to life with shaded outdoor spaces and a vegetable garden.

facts.text: The JW Garden grows local herbs used to flavor the restaurant and bar menus.
facts.excerpt: Our JW Garden concept feautures a variety of local herbs grown and sourced to flavor the restaurant and bar menus with authentic Cretan aromas.

facts.text: Ōnalos is a beachfront seafood restaurant with a sea-to-table concept and Aegean flavors.
facts.excerpt: A beachfront seafood restaurant in Chania with a refined sea-to-table concept and Aegean flavors.

facts.text: The Eéxis bar's cocktail list combines Cretan botanicals and herbs with modern techniques.
facts.excerpt: The cocktail list features a bespoke mixology concept combining Cretan botanicals and herbs with modern techniques.

facts.text: A boat trip takes guests to Balos and Gramvousa, protected by the Natura 2000 program, with a stop at Menies Cove.
facts.excerpt: The boat trip invites you to explore Balos Gramvousa, Crete’s most breathtaking coastal treasure protected by the Natura 2000 program

facts.text: Local experiences include hiking and wine or olive oil tasting.
facts.excerpt: Engage in authentic local experiences such as hiking, wine or olive oil tasting

facts.text: Curated experiences include a ceramic workshop and a walking tour to Chania Old Town.
facts.excerpt:

facts.text: The resort closes for part of the year and operates seasonally.
facts.excerpt: JW Marriott Crete Resort & Spa is now closed for the season.

facts.text: Pets are welcome.
facts.excerpt: Pets Welcome.
